result_text: Both tooltips now escape repository names, so `acme "shop"` shows as text. I changed one file: `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/landscape/statichtml/LandscapeReportGenerator.java`. - **Language tooltip** (`addLangInfo(NumericMetric)`, around line 1197): each repository name is passed through `StringEscapeUtils.escapeHtml4` before the `(N LOC)` suffix is appended. This covers the main, test and other variants, since they all use this method. - **Size distribution tooltip** (around line 1454): the repository name is escaped the same way before the lines of code are appended. - **Import:** added `org.apache.commons.text.StringEscapeUtils`, which the module already uses elsewhere. Counts, LOC values, ordering and layout are unchanged. The tooltips are written into a `title="..."` attribute, so escaping the name makes the browser show the original text. `mvn -o -pl reports test` builds and passes. The module has no landscape-specific tests, so I did not render a report to check the tooltips in a browser. I have not committed.
